steps: Enroll in an online accounting fundamentals course (e.g., Coursera's 'Accounting: Principles of Financial Accounting') to build core accounting knowledge.
Take a free course on financial reporting (e.g., edX's 'Financial Reporting and Analysis') to understand how to prepare and analyze financial statements.
Learn risk assessment basics through a short course like 'Risk Management for Finance' on LinkedIn Learning.
Practice bookkeeping and budgeting using software like QuickBooks or Excel templates to solidify bridge skills.
Explore AI training in finance via a workshop or online module (e.g., 'AI for Finance' on Udemy) to future-proof your skill set.
